dogecoin.text: Let’s examine how risk takers rule the world politically and economically. Assuming that on March 28, 2021 you invested $5,000 in Dogecoin at $0.06 and received 83,333.33 worth of coins. That means, as of yesterday, May 7, 2021, you would have $58,333.33 at $0.70 per coin.

Why I am not moved by what happened to Dogecoin during SNL: 

2 hours before the show I converted over 70% of my Doge holdings to Ethereum (ETH) at $.66. This is called hedging my position to reduce risk that I anticipated.
